generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder Condition

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tender will not be considered Condition
Tender application amount will not be refundable Condition
The employer reserves the right to accept any tender and to reject any or all tenders without assigning any reason Condition
The contractor has to compete the bid (quote the rates) for all schedule B items of the works mentioned
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted

The Contractor shall pay the Earnest Money Deposit EMD & tender transaction fee in the Kppp portal using any of the following payment modes Credit Card, Direct Debit,OTC, National Electronic Fund transfer NEFT

The tenderer shall scan and upload all the original documents required for this bid to the Kppp portal. the original documents shall be produced at the time of physical verifcation otherwise the tenders will be treated as Nonresponsive & liable for rejection
One percent of the bill amount of the successful tenderer will be deducted towards cess as a labour welfare fund
The contractor has to make his own arrangement for procurement of all materials required for the work. there is no departmental supply of materials

All documents enclosed should be attested by Gazetted ofcer or Government Notary,otherwise the bids are liable for disqualifcation.Original documents should be produced for verifcation at any stage of the tender process, as and when sought for. Failure to produce original documents will lead to disqualifcation. work done certifcates should have all the CR no, work order issuing date, work completion date and year
The tenderer shall have valid Class IV & Above Registration Certifcate
Omission and typographical errors which are in the opinion of the executive Engineer will not be a ground for claims of extra payment
Royalty charges will be deducted from the contractors running bill as per the prevailing royalty charges at the time of payment
The tenders are invited as per Standard tender Bid Document KW-1 and shall abide for the conditions contained in Standard tender Bid Document KW-1

Executive engineer reserves the right to accept or reject any tender and to cancel the tender process and reject all tenders at any time prior to award of contract, without there by incurring any liability to the affected tenderer or tenderers or any obligation to inform the affected tenderer or tenderers of the grounds for the employers action
IT & GST will be deducted as per government order

Contractors have to upload the Certifcates of works in hand of any Department/Institutions failing which the tender will not be considered. Action will be taken as per clause 31 of SECTION 2: INSTRUCTIONS TO TENDERERS (ITT) in case of incomplete/ false documents regarding works in hand for the calculation of tender capacity

If mineral dispatch permits not submitted by contractors for usage of respective minerals for construction the royalty charges with penalty will be deducted from the contractors running bill as per the direction given by concern department or government at the time of payment
Restrictions on Public Procurement from Bidders of certain countries as per Government order No.FD 455 Exp-12 2020 Bengaluru dated:25-08-2020

The contractor should obtain the Material Dispatch Permit for stone, aggregates, sand and murrum etc will be used in the construction work from the Mines and Geology department at the time of execution and same should be submitted along with the work bill, then for such work bills no Royalty will be deducted. If the contractor failed to submit the Material Dispatch Permit along with the work bill Five times Royalty will be deducted from the work bill as per KMMCR 2016 amendment rule 44(4) and the circular vide No.Ga.Bhu.E/DCB/DCB/takte/2019- 20/4497 Dated :12/12/2019 by Mines and Geology department
Tenderers shall provide the requested information accurately as per Bid document
All documents to be furnished are to be counter signed by the employer in charge, not below the rank of an executive in-charge or equivalent
Annual turnover certifcate along with Balance sheet certifed/attested by Chartered Accountants should be uploaded with 18-Digits system generated unique number (UDIN Number)

The rates quoted shall be for fnished items of work exclusive of all applicable taxes, inclusive of all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, all incidental charges and local or general royalty etc., complete payable to the Government or local bodies in the region
Valid GST, ESI & EPF certifcate

ITT (3.2(b) To qualify for award of this contract , Mandating satisfactory completion as a prime contractor, at leastat least one similar nature of work (in the last fve years periodi.e. 2021-22, 2022-23 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) to an extent of 25% of the cost of the work for all works costing up to Rs.1.01 Lakhs.

IIT 3.2(a) To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) achieved in at least ONE financial year a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs.4.03 Lakhs(in all classes of civil engineering construction works only)
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste category as prescribed in the tender document.
The contractor belonging to the Scheduled Caste shall be domicile of the state of Karnataka for more than 10 year

The contractor should up load the certificate issued from the labour dept and EPF andESI certificates. The contractor should pay the wage for labour as per schedule of rates.The contractor should pay the wage for labour as per schedule of rates. The contractorquoting less rates for labour will be rejected
Contractors who have not completed the works in time in this division will not be entitledto Bid and if participated it will not be considered

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Annual Maintenance of Vasudevarahalli Pickup in Aluru Taluk, Hassan district for the year of 2026-27

itemList.description: Clearing and grubbing road land including uprooting rank vegetation, grass, bushes, shrubs, saplings and trees girth up to 300 mm, removal of stumps of trees cut earlier and disposal of unserviceable materials and stacking of serviceable material to be used or auctioned, including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness  (ii) By Mechanical Means using Dozer  (a) In area of light jungle

De-silting of Feeder Channel/Canal in dry condition by excavating the deposited bed material and loading the same to transport vehicle ( excluding cost of transportation ) including cost of all machinery, labour & all necessary works as directed and complete as per specification.

Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50m lift upto 1.5m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenances required to complete the work. --- In all kinds of soils depth upto 3.00m

Providing and laying in-situ vibrated M-15 grade cement concrete using 40 mm down approved, clean, hard, graded aggregates for plain concrete works including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, providing mortar layer for lift joints, batching, mixing, placing in position, levelling, vibrating, finishing, curing with all other ancillary operations complete.

Providing and laying insitu vibrated M-20 ( 28 days cube compressive strength not less than 20 N / sq mm ) grade cement concrete using 20  mm down size approved, clean, hard, graded aggregates as per relevant  IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage  charges of machinery, curing, centering, formwork and scafolding and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical  specifications for check dam /pickups /irrigation tanks/waste weir/ sluice, sluice canal and other allied works like abutments/wing  walls/returns/cutoff walls works & all necessary works as directed  and complete as per specification.

Steel Fabrication: Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification.--- All other type of structures

Fabrication, supply, erection, testing and commissioning of sliding type vertical lift gate consisting of skin plate, horizontal and vertical stiffeners, seal seats, sponge rubber seals lifting handles etc., with all accessories for vented dam / field channel including cost of all materials, labour, cutting, aligning, welding, finishing, cleaning, applying two coats of anticorrosive bituminous black paint over a coat of zinc chromate red oxide primer paint, seal fixing etc., complete as per specifications and approved drawings with all leads and lifts.

Providing casing embankment  using  semi-pervious / pervious  soil  from   dump  areas  in  layers  of   250 to 300 mm  (before compaction)  including cost of all materials, machinery,  labour, all other   operations  such as collection of soil, spreading soil in layer  of  specified  thickness,   sorting  out,  breaking clods,  levelling,  sectioning  edges  /  sides,  watering, compacting each layer to density control of not less than  95 percent or as stipulated using power roller  and all other ancillary operations complete.
